note: New synthetic support tickets written for this prospective review on 2026-11-20. English is the model input. The Chinese text is a reading aid. The full queue was fixed before reviewer labels or model calls.

items.state: The driver is due on Friday, when our reception desk is closed. Can the box be left at the pickup shop on Pine Street instead?
items.reading_aid_zh: 司机周五来送货，那天我们的前台不上班。能把箱子送到松树街的取件点吗？

items.state: We went from ten paid seats to four halfway through the month. How did you calculate what we owe for that month?
items.reading_aid_zh: 月中我们把付费席位从十个减到了四个。那个月应付的金额是怎么算的？

items.state: I got an email that just says ‘action required’ and gives a case number. What am I supposed to do next?
items.reading_aid_zh: 我收到一封邮件，上面只写着‘需要采取行动’，还给了一个工单号。我接下来该做什么？

items.state: I can see 43 entries on the screen. When I export that same list, the CSV contains only the column headings.
items.reading_aid_zh: 屏幕上能看到 43 条记录，可我把这份列表导出成 CSV 文件后，里面只有列名。

items.state: We need someone to sign for the shipment at the lab. Separately, the portal keeps erasing my colleague's phone number, even on unrelated orders. Can you help with both?
items.reading_aid_zh: 送到实验室的货需要有人签收。另外，网站总是把我同事的电话号码清掉，连其他订单也这样。两件事都能帮忙处理吗？

items.state: Captions work for the first few seconds of every training video, then the words stop changing while the speaker carries on talking.
items.reading_aid_zh: 每段培训视频的字幕头几秒都正常，之后讲话的人还在继续说，字幕却停在了原处。

items.state: I returned a coat that cost 60 euros and got 54 euros back. Could you tell me what the six euros were deducted for?
items.reading_aid_zh: 我退了一件 60 欧元的外套，收到了 54 欧元。能告诉我那 6 欧元是因为什么扣的吗？

items.state: I kept the afternoon free for someone to pick up the return. Nobody came, and the box is still here. Can we book another collection?
items.reading_aid_zh: 我空出一下午等人来取退货，结果没人来，箱子还在我这里。能再约一次上门取件吗？

items.state: There's an orange triangle beside yesterday's entry. It has no caption. What do I need to do about it?
items.reading_aid_zh: 昨天那条记录旁边多了一个橙色三角形，没有任何说明。我需要怎么处理？

items.state: My bank lists this purchase in yen. Before I ask them about the conversion, could you tell me the amount and currency you originally billed?
items.reading_aid_zh: 我的银行把这笔消费列成了日元。在我找银行问汇率之前，能告诉我你们最初用什么币种收了多少钱吗？

items.state: I left a workspace last week but still get its push notifications on my phone. I've already turned off notifications for that workspace in the app.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我上周就退出了一个工作区，现在手机上还会收到它的推送。我已经在应用里关掉了那个工作区的通知。

items.state: The carrier sent the parcel back before I could collect it. Could you arrange another delivery to the same address?
items.reading_aid_zh: 我还没来得及取件，承运商就把包裹退回去了。能安排再送一次到原地址吗？

items.state: Your statement still lists our bank transfer as unpaid. The download button is stuck too, but please match the transfer to our order first.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我们已经转账，你们的对账单上却还写着未付款。下载按钮也卡住了，不过请先把这笔转账核对到我们的订单上。

items.state: Two notices came this morning with different deadlines. Neither says what they're about. Which one applies to me?
items.reading_aid_zh: 今天早上我收到了两份通知，截止日期不一样，也都没说是为了什么。哪个日期对我有效？

items.state: My weekly reminder is set for 9 a.m. London time. Since the clocks changed, it goes off at eight even though the settings still say nine.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我把每周提醒设在伦敦时间上午九点。时钟换季调过之后，设置里仍然写着九点，提醒却会在八点响。

items.state: Who takes over my international shipment after it clears customs? I'd like the name of the carrier so I can contact the local depot.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我的国际包裹清关后由哪家公司接手？我想知道承运商的名字，好联系当地的站点。

items.state: We sent you our tax exemption certificate before buying the equipment. Why does this purchase still include sales tax?
items.reading_aid_zh: 我们购买设备前已经把免税证明交给了你们，为什么这笔消费还是含了销售税？

items.state: I'll need proof of payment eventually. For now please help me open the shared folder. My teammates can still get in, but I see ‘permission denied’.
items.reading_aid_zh: 付款凭证我过些时候会要。现在请先帮我打开共享文件夹。同事都还能进去，只有我这里提示‘权限不足’。

items.state: The replacement part should go to our warehouse and the documents to our office. Can you confirm the address on each shipping label before they leave?
items.reading_aid_zh: 替换零件要去仓库，文件要寄到办公室。寄出之前，能帮我确认两个面单上各写的是什么地址吗？

items.state: My screen reader reads every menu item twice. Also, the latest bill lists a seat we never ordered. I need both looked into.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我的屏幕阅读器会把每个菜单项读两遍。另外，最新的账单里有一个我们从没订过的席位。两件事都请帮我查一下。

items.state: The furniture comes on a wooden pallet. Will the driver take the pallet away when they drop the furniture off? We have nowhere to store it.
items.reading_aid_zh: 家具是放在木托盘上送来的。司机送到后会把托盘带走吗？我们这里没有地方放。

items.state: I paid for two items partly with a gift card and partly with my debit card. If I return just one item, where will that money go?
items.reading_aid_zh: 我买两件商品时，一部分用礼品卡付，一部分用借记卡付。如果只退其中一件，那笔钱会退到哪里？

items.state: I type a note in Japanese and it looks fine until I save it. When I reopen the note every character is a question mark.
items.reading_aid_zh: 我输入了一段日文，保存前看着都正常。保存后再打开，所有字都变成了问号。

items.state: The courier needs my flat number for the next delivery, and last month's credit is missing from my balance. I'd like both sorted out today.
items.reading_aid_zh: 快递员下次送货时需要我的房号，上个月该记入我账户余额的抵扣额也还没显示。我希望这两件事今天都能处理。
